desc: Identify the set S of indices where A_i != B_i, and separate them by their initial value in A (0 or 1).
Derive the cost contribution of flipping a position i depending on the current number of 1s, and express the total cost in terms of the flip order.
Use an exchange argument to find the optimal relative ordering between flipping a 0-position and a 1-position.
Prove the optimal global ordering criterion (offs before ons, sorted by C) and reduce the computation to the suffix property over matched 1s sorted by C descending.
Implement the O(N log N) solution (R/T/M split, prefix sums, two-pointer scan over p) and validate against samples 1,2,3 — all PASSED (16, 0, 2867).
